gtna.machine.nexus_molecular_forge.toolt: Queues jobs from Nexus Craft Pattern Hatches and materializes them in giant batches.
Parallel crafting follows the AE2 CPU and is optimized for extreme throughput.
Each operation materializes every queued craft output at once.
Queued crafts do not consume physical ingredients.
Power Cost: 1 EU per crafted item, compressed into batch EU/t.
HUD shows pattern hatches, loaded patterns, queued outputs, active batch, and forge ceiling.

gtna.machine.industrial_platform_deploym: Deploys prefabricated platform and factory presets directly into the world
Consumes hydraulic deployment materials from its internal inventory
Industrial-scale deployment tool for platforms, roads, and factory shells.
Step 1: browse the preset library and lock in the structure you want.
Step 2: load hydraulic materials and any additional items the preset requires.
Step 3: adjust chunk offsets, Y offset, mirrors, rotation, and placement speed.
Coordinate Cards can also define an export area for structure capture.
